description: PHI, 2005 June regular phase: 49 of 49 selections from MLB's draft feed (historical importer).

coverage_claims.gap_notes: MLB's draft feed lists 49 selection(s) for the club in the June regular phase. Independent count: 49 (Baseball-Reference franchise-year page, Internet Archive capture 20240725013750: 49 listed, 48 matched to MLB's picks by name (3 by surname in the same round: #397 MLB "Matthew Olson" / "Matt Olson"; #517 MLB "Ronald Hill" / "Ron Hill"; #817 MLB "Steven Alexander" / "Steve Alexander"); 1 unmatched there, 1 of MLB's not listed there). Signing status, bonuses and outcomes not researched.
